info.name: backend
info.description:
Rust/Axum API backend for simplebash-pos, a point-of-sale system for a repair/retail shop.

All requests inherit the collection-level Bearer auth (`{{accessToken}}`) — set it once per environment (Development/Production) after obtaining a JWT via Auth > Login (its Tests script auto-populates `{{accessToken}}`/`{{userId}}` for you on success, so nothing to copy/paste). Admin-gated endpoints (inventory category/subcategory writes, Billing > Void Invoice / Close Invoice, and every Suppliers/Supplier Products/Purchases request — reads included) require the token's `role` claim to be `admin`. Permission-gated endpoints (all of Inventory except the module-status stub, Customers writes, Employees CRUD, Billing > Complete Sale/Record Payment/Credit Notes, Repairs writes, Print Jobs writes, Quotations (every route, `quotations:manage` — Admin and Manager only), Reports reads (`reports:view`), Users CRUD, Auth > List Login Sessions) require the token's `permissions` claim to include a specific permission (e.g. `inventory:read`, `inventory:write`, `customers:write`, `employees:read`, `employees:write`, `billing:write`, `repairs:write`, `print_jobs:write`, `quotations:manage`, `reports:view`, `users:manage`, `sessions:view`) — see CLAUDE.md's "Auth, users & permissions" section for the full role→permission table; the default seeded Admin (`cargo run --bin seed_all` or `cargo run --bin seed_admin` with credentials `admin@pos.com` / `admin@1234`) has every permission. Users CRUD is additionally scoped by an Admin/Manager hierarchy on top of that permission gate — see the Users folder's description.

Only these endpoints work without a token at all: Health, Auth > Login, Swagger, and the `GET /` module-status stubs still remaining on Inventory/Billing/Reports (Customers, Repairs, Employees, and Print Jobs have real authenticated `GET /` list endpoints). Everything else returns 401 `UNAUTHORIZED` without a valid Bearer token, and 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`/`ADMIN_REQUIRED` if the token lacks the required permission or role.

Base URL (`{{backendBaseUrl}}`), and the access token, are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment to point requests at dev vs prod.

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Exchanges username/password for a JWT carrying the account's role and its role's default permission set. No auth required. On success, this request's Tests script auto-populates the `{{accessToken}}`/`{{userId}}` environment variables, so every other request's inherited Bearer auth picks it up immediately.

Use `cargo run --bin seed_admin` or `cargo run --bin seed_all` to bootstrap default seed data including the Admin account (admin@pos.com / admin@1234). Registration is admin-provisioned only — there is no public register endpoint.

**`shopCode`** (multi-tenant deployments only, `TENANT_MODE=multi`): the shop's login code from the platform directory (create one with `cargo run --bin create_tenant -- <shop-code> "<Business name>"`). Required there (400 if missing; an unknown code returns the same 401 as a wrong password) and it puts the issued token's `tid` claim on that tenant. Single-shop deployments ignore it, so it is safe to leave in the body.

Returns the account the inherited Bearer token belongs to. Re-reads from MongoDB on every call (rather than only decoding the token), so a deactivated account is caught immediately even with a still-valid token.

**Requires a valid JWT** or the API returns 401.

item.name: Billing

request.description: Liveness and placeholder status check for the billing module.

Completes a sale: creates the invoice (and, unless `payment.isCredit`, its payment record(s)), decrements stock for any `productKey` line items, and marks any linked repair/print-job ticket (`sourceTicketKey`) delivered. `cashierId` is never sent — the completing cashier is always the bearer token's user. There is no tax in this system. The request is grouped into sub-objects: `staff{cashierName}`, `customer{}` (optional — omit for a walk-in with no linked account; only used as typed when `customerKey` is absent, otherwise resolved from the linked `Customer` record), `items[]`, `pricingAdjustments{}` (optional — omit for no discount; `discountType` is `"percentage"` [0-100, e.g. 7.5] or `"fixed"` [a cents amount]; the server computes the actual `discountCents` from this against the resolved subtotal), and `payment{paymentMethod, isCredit, amountReceivedCents, splitPayments, cardLast4, cardRef, onlineRef, onlineNote, dueDate}`. `shopProfileSnapshot`/`notes`/`warrantyTermsSnapshot`/`documentSelection` stay top-level. Line items are resolved server-side, never trusted from the payload: a retail item's `name`/`sku`/`unitPriceCents` come from the product record via `productKey`, a repair/print item's `unitPriceCents`/`assignedEmployeeName`/`sourceTicketNumber` come from the ticket via `sourceTicketKey`, and an item's `totalCents` is always computed as `unitPriceCents * quantity - discountCents`. `name`/`unitPriceCents` are only required on an item when it has no `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey` to resolve from (an ad-hoc line). `subtotalCents`/`totalCents`/`changeDueCents` are likewise never sent — `subtotalCents` is the sum of the resolved items' `totalCents`, `totalCents` is `subtotalCents - discountCents`, and `changeDueCents` (when `payment.amountReceivedCents` is given) is `amountReceivedCents - totalCents`. An unresolvable `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey`/`customerKey` rejects the whole request before any write. `warnings` in the response surfaces any post-write side effect (stock decrement, ticket status, customer balance) that failed without rolling back the already-durable invoice/payment — see CLAUDE.md's billing module notes.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. Returns 401 without a token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the permission is ever revoked from a role, 400 for an invalid `pricingAdjustments`/split-leg total, 404 if a `productKey`/`sourceTicketKey`/`customerKey` doesn't resolve.

Every product line (non-serialized) names the price tier it is sold at in `sellingPriceCents` — one of the product's `priceTiers` (400 when missing, 409 `PRICE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE` when no in-stock batch sells at it, 409 `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` when the tier holds too few units). The units are drawn from that tier's batches oldest first and recorded on the invoice line as `batchAllocations`; the line's `unitCostCents` is their weighted cost. A serialized line sends `serialNumbers` instead and is priced at its units' batch. One line per product and price.

request.description:
Renders (or returns the cached) PDF for an invoice. `documentType` in the path is `a4-invoice` or `thermal-receipt` — this request is the A4 variant; duplicate it and change the last path segment for the receipt, which also accepts the `paperWidthMm` query param (58 or 80, default 80). Which design prints is the shop's choice for that kind (Settings → Document Designs, `GET/PUT /api/settings/document-templates`), or the standard design when nothing was chosen; add `?template=<design id>` to use a different design for this one print (422 `TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE` if it does not exist or is for another kind of document). Response is `application/pdf` bytes, not the usual JSON envelope.

**Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim — granted to every role by default (see `core::constants::roles::default_permissions`), so in practice any logged-in user may call it; the check exists for future role tuning. **Requires a valid Bearer token** (any role — `CurrentUser`, no specific permission) or the API returns 401.

Creates a credit note against an existing invoice (or, with `noReceipt: true` + `overrideReason` + an Admin token, without one): adjusts stock per returned line's `condition`/`disposition`, calculates net cashback or extra amount due (capped at what was actually paid, allocated across payment methods via `refundBreakdown` for a split-paid invoice), updates customer financials, and updates the invoice's returned quantity / `refundedCents` / `creditNoteCount`.

**Requires the `billing:write` permission** in the token's `permissions` claim. No-receipt and past-return-window requests additionally require the caller to hold `Role::Admin`, with a non-empty `overrideReason`. Returns 401 without token, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`/`MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED`, 400 if return quantity exceeds purchased quantity or a `damaged` line has no `disposition`, 404 if invoice/product not found, 409 `INVOICE_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_CREDIT_NOTE` if the invoice is voided, `RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED` if past the window without override.

Returned units go back into the stock batches the invoice line sold them from (newest first). A product sold at two prices is on two invoice lines; send the line's price as `sellingPriceCents` so the return lands on the right one (a price the invoice never sold it at is a 400). A no-receipt product line must also send `sellingPriceCents` (the price it was sold at); it is valued at that price and restocked into the newest batch ever sold at it (409 `PRICE_TIER_UNAVAILABLE` if none). Exchange items are priced and drawn from batches exactly like sale lines.

request.description:
Categories a drawer cash movement can be filed under, best first: pinned, then most used by this shop, then the shop's own order. Merged-away categories never appear. `usageCount` is counted at read time (merged categories add to their target).

**Requires `cash_movements:view`** (all roles). `includeHidden=true` and `needsReview=true` also need `cash_categories:manage` (Admin and Manager).

query.description: One of: petty_expense | rent_and_bills | staff_payment | supplier_payment | owner_withdrawal | add_cash | cash_drop | no_sale

request.description:
Existing categories whose name is close to a typed one (typos or containment), so the cashier can pick one instead of adding a near-duplicate. At most 3.

**Requires `cash_categories:create`** (all roles).

Add a category for one kind of payment. Names are 2 to 40 letters and unique per kind of payment ignoring case and spacing (409 `CASH_CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN`, or `CASH_CATEGORY_HIDDEN` when the name belongs to a hidden category). A cashier can only add to petty_expense, add_cash, cash_drop and no_sale (403 `CASH_CATEGORY_TYPE_RESTRICTED` otherwise) and the category waits for review; a manager can add to any kind and choose `reportGroup`.

**Requires `cash_categories:create`** (all roles).

Rename, hide (`active: false`), pin, reorder, set the receipt rule or an approval limit (`requiresApprovalOverCents`, 0 clears it), set the report group, or approve a cashier-made category (`approve: true`). Absent fields are unchanged. The built-in Other category cannot be renamed or hidden.

**Requires `cash_categories:manage`** (Admin and Manager).

Merge a duplicate into another category of the same kind of payment. Movements keep their key (they are never edited); the merged category redirects readers to the target, so history and reports follow. Built-in categories cannot be merged away.

**Requires `cash_categories:manage`** (Admin and Manager).

The shop's drawer rules: `undoWindowSeconds`, `approvalThresholdCents` (absent = no shop-wide limit), `quickAmountsCents` and `floatTargetCents` (absent = none), `version`. Every shop has them from the start (seeded with Rs. 100/500/1,000/5,000 quick amounts and a 120 second undo window).

**Requires `cash_movements:view`** (every role: the cash form reads them).

Replaces the whole set; an absent `approvalThresholdCents` or `floatTargetCents` clears that rule. `undoWindowSeconds` 10 to 3600; every amount more than zero and at most Rs. 1,000,000; 1 to 8 `quickAmountsCents`, strictly ascending. The shop-wide approval limit only applies to cash leaving the drawer.

**Requires `cash_settings:manage`** (Admin only).

Record one drawer cash event. `movementType` is one of petty_expense | rent_and_bills | staff_payment | supplier_payment | owner_withdrawal | add_cash | cash_drop | no_sale. The category must belong to that kind of payment and be visible; `customLabel` is only for the type's Other category. Each type asks for its own fields and refuses the rest: rent_and_bills needs a vendor `payeeKey` and `periodStart`/`periodEnd` (YYYY-MM-DD); staff_payment a staff `payeeKey`; supplier_payment a supplier `payeeKey`; owner_withdrawal a `payeeName`; no_sale has `amountCents` 0 and no payee. A name typed on a petty_expense is saved to the payee list. A manager or owner `managerPin` is required for owner_withdrawal, staff_payment and any payout above the category's `requiresApprovalOverCents`. `sessionKey` may be omitted only for cash taken out between shifts.

**Requires `cash_movements:create`**; rent_and_bills, staff_payment and supplier_payment also need `cash_movements:create:managed` (Admin and Manager).

A payout (any outgoing kind or a cash drop) bigger than the cash the drawer holds (the open shift's expected cash, or the drawer's running balance between shifts) is refused with 409 `DRAWER_CASH_EXCEEDED` unless a manager or owner `managerPin` and an `overrideReason` are sent; both are kept on the entry (`approvedBy…`, `approvalReason`).

A rent_and_bills payment for a month that is already paid (a regular bill paid in full, or anything recorded for that category and payee when there is no regular bill) is refused with 409 `PERIOD_ALREADY_PAID` unless `confirmDuplicate` is true.

request.description:
Cancel a movement by recording its opposite; the original is never edited or deleted. Its `undoUntil` says how long the person who recorded it can undo it without a manager (120 seconds); after that, or for someone else's movement, only a Manager or Admin (`cash_movements:reverse`) can, and `reason` is required. The drawer and the shift's totals move back. A movement can be reversed once (409 `MOVEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED`); a reversal or a no-sale open cannot be reversed (400 `MOVEMENT_NOT_REVERSIBLE`); the shift must be open. A reversed drawer payment stops counting as an expense.

**Requires `cash_movements:create`.**
